maria: FYI seeing a p95 spike for small-text models in eu-west since ~03:20 UTC. traces point to long tail on first token, not model CPU. :thinking:
zhang: logs look like host-level IRQ coalescing and NVMe/PCIe DMA stalls aligning with MIG slice switches. noisy timeline matches a couple of big batch jobs that landed on the same nodes. i can paste a kernel irqstat snippet:
zhang: ```irq/eth0:  avg_ns=2300000 count=12456 dev=eth0
irq/pci-0000:65:00.0: avg_ns=9800000 count=4123 dev=nvme0n1
softirq:  net_rx=2200 net_tx=100 timer=15000
```
sam: hmm, irq bursts + MIG context switches could push KV cache misses into the slow path. any recent scheduler bin-packing changes?
maria: we rolled the new slab-packer yesterday (canaries only) but this looks broader. affected nodes are mixed-type (2x 80GB + 4x small GPUs) with fractional slices enabled.
ryan: quick mitigation idea: reduce NIC rx-usecs and pin batchers away from low-latency slices. also try disabling irq coalescing spikes via ethtool and bumping RPS. e.g.:
ryan: ```sudo ethtool -C eth0 rx-usecs 250 rx-frames 1
echo 4 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/all/rp_filter # (example)
echo 16384 > /proc/sys/net/core/rmem_default
```
lia: can we do a targeted warm migration before next peak? move those heavy-filling allocations to dedicated warm-pools for 10m window. cost impact small but buys p95 headroom.
ops-bot: autoscaler: initiated warm-pool carveout in eu-west (3 nodes) per @lia request — job id 9f8c.
zhang: ran a small probe after ethtool change on one host, first-token latency dropped ~30% on the probe tenant, but NVMe stall counters still tick. suspect PCIe DMA queue depth imbalance when vmProfiles share root complex.
sam: long-term: we should teach allocator to consider host IRQ & DMA contention as a soft-affinity feature. low-latency tenants get a "quiet" host tag (no background batchers, no heavy nvme i/o) — fallback to dedicated slice if quiet hosts exceed threshold.
maria: agree. short-term action items: 1) continue warm-pool carveout (lia) 2) ethtool/rps tweak on affected rack (ryan + ops) 3) collect nvme/irq counters for 6h and correlate with allocator decisions (zhang). volunteers?
ryan: i'll do ethtool + RPS changes and share a one-line checklist for SRE runbook. :thumbsup:
zhang: i'll ship a small agent to dump irq/pcie/kvcache stats to ops-metrics every 60s, then we can build a quiet-host signal.
sam: i'll sketch allocator changes for quiet-host soft-affinity and cost tradeoffs, include how to score in the packing optimizer.
maria: awesome — copy me on checklists. if the probe holds we'll do a slow roll of slab-packer canary back to default config and monitor. :eyes:
